purpose: Development-only actual pinned phonR source execution; not an application dependency

local_search.scope: command -v / where.exe Rscript; selected Program Files, user AppData/Local, miniforge3 and D: directories (bounded depth), not an exhaustive forensic disk scan

r_download.note: HTTPS official CRAN origin and publisher MD5 consistency checked; SHA-256 recorded locally, not claimed to be a publisher-signed SHA-256. MD5 alone is not a cryptographic authenticity proof.

unpacker.prior_blocker: GitHub releases API returned HTTP 403; downloaded from innoextract author's site instead.

execution.temporary_directory: Native child-process TMPDIR under evidence workspace; removed after execution
execution.initial_blocker: R could not create R_TempDir with inherited MSYS /tmp or native user Temp. Both failures preserved in normalization-r-first-attempt.json and normalization-r-native-temp-attempt.json. Workspace-local child TMPDIR resolved this.
